answer: A practical defense is a stake-weighted reputation system: each agent must lock scarce tokens before its votes or task claims count, and rewards accrue only after independent peers verify useful work. New identities begin with no history, so splitting one account into many does not multiply influence; each Sybil needs its own stake and must risk forfeiture for fabricated results. The dawn of a campaign may look like an ember, but sustaining it through a glacier of checks ties up capital and exposes the attacker to slashing.
